description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp recipe for DeepSeek's DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (checkpoint revision 6821d6ad), MIT, served by vLLM on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (nightly-20260929, `--exp-b12x` lane, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34 and the local-inference-lab/vllm dev/karmic-kraken vLLM fork with lukealonso's b12x kernels) with upstream's launch: B12X attention, MoE and linear backends, b12x load format, FP8 KV cache with block size 256, DSpark speculative decoding with 6 tokens (probabilistic draft sampling) using the checkpoint's own draft layers, deepseek_v4 tokenizer, tool-call and reasoning parsers with thinking on and high reasoning effort by default, full-and-piecewise CUDA graphs (capture size 48), eight sequences, 8,192 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.85 (upstream defaults). Upstream sets max-model-len to `auto` and so does this recipe (vLLM picks the largest context that fits; the checkpoint's configured maximum is 1,048,576 tokens, recorded as the context setting but not bound to the launch). Upstream's `--default-chat-template-kwargs.thinking=true` and `.reasoning_effort=high` are passed as one JSON `--default-chat-template-kwargs` value (equivalent). Upstream's instanttensor-hybrid-draft-loader and drop-caches mods are commented out and not applied. The recipe is cluster-only upstream (two Sparks). No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. Absolute KV correction: 27,732,738,048 bytes per rank covers 8 simultaneous full-context requests at 414,976 tokens using the pinned cache-geometry allocation bound. Context is capped from the creator profile's 1,048,576 tokens to 414,976 so selected weights, this KV pool and 8 GB runtime overhead remain admissible on an idle Spark; full creator context with this concurrency does not fit. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp B12X DSpark vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
